name: TR-MPC
author: sd88me
summary: A modular 16-slot drum kit: each slot plays any of the 49 voices of athousanddetails' 6W6, 8W8, CW-78 and 9W9 (a 606 kick beside an 808 snare and 909 hats), with per-slot level, tune, decay, drive, pan and sends, one shared reverb, delay and master chain, a randomise module, and a touchscreen skin that reskins each slot to its voice's kit.
